scripts.postinstall: npm run prisma:generate -w apps/api && npm run build -w packages/shared
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/worker && npm run build -w apps/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/worker && npm run lint -w apps/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/worker
